name: action
title: The action cartridge: bow, sear and trigger printed in place in a tray that pins into the frame
orientation: Flat on the bed on its floor, open side up, as it prints: every flexure bends within its layers. It goes into the frame's cavity open side first and is pinned through its floor from inside. The sled's tab reaches down into it through the gap in its top, the sear's tooth up out of it.

width.rule: Every flexure's height off the bed

wall.rule: The base everything stands on: the body's bed wall

slot.rule: The barrel slot's height: the disc and a fit each side

body_z.rule: The slot's walls' height off the bed: the lid sits on them

travel.rule: How far the bow is drawn: 0 at rest, launcher.travel when cocked

travel_max.rule: The full draw the leaf is sized for

overrun.rule: The sled's rest is this far ahead of the leaf's

draw.rule: The leaf's force at full draw

leaf_t.rule: The leaf's thickness, six lines: what the sizing picks for the draw at the travel (the build checks)

leaf_len.rule: The leaf's length: what the sizing gives for the draw at the travel (the build checks it, within half a millimetre), so the grip's bottom is a plain number

max_leaf.rule: The longest leaf allowed: it runs down inside the grip

rest_x.rule: The tab's rear face at rest, ahead of the bead by the overrun

root_block.rule: The block the leaf grows from

overlap.rule: How far parts sink into each other, so they join

bite.rule: How far the leaf's tip reaches up the tab from its bottom: more than the tip drops as it bends, less than the bead's radius covers of the leaf's lean

tip_y.rule: The leaf's tip: the tab's bottom plus the bite

sear_len.rule: The sear's leaf: long enough that the trigger's lift stays under the strain limit

sear_w.rule: The sear's width: from the bed wall to beside the tab's path

undercut.rule: How far the sear's tooth stands into the slot, over the sled's front edge

lead.rule: The tooth's ramp: the sled rides over it when cocked

sear_gap.rule: The sear's leaf below the floor's underside

foot.rule: The foot under the sear's tip, and the shelf it carries back towards the trigger: the trigger's arm fits between the leaf and the shelf

shelf.rule: The shelf's reach back from the foot

sear_block.rule: The block the sear's leaf grows from

hinge_block.rule: The trigger's arm thickness: it fits between the sear's leaf and its shelf

trigger_x.rule: The trigger's pivot ahead of the leaf's rest: its hinge post stands clear of the tab's run, and the leaf bends away from it

finger_arm.rule: From the pivot down to the finger: the finger's travel over this is the hinge's turn

arm_t.rule: The finger arm's thickness along the barrel

hinge_arms.rule: The living hinge's blocks either side of its strip

pull.rule: How far the trigger is pulled: 0 at rest, launcher.trigger_travel when fired

pull_max.rule: The finger's full travel, to the stop

bead.rule: A round bead along the leaf's tip, the radius of its thickness: the tab is pushed at the tip whatever the leaf's lean, so the draw is the tip's travel

tooth_back.value: bead - travel_max + sled.reach + sled.length + sled.nose + fit
tooth_back.rule: The sear tooth's holding face: a fit ahead of the sled's nose when cocked

grip_bottom.rule: The cartridge's bottom edge, outer face: under the leaf's root block and the wall

case_back.rule: The cartridge's back wall, outer face: behind the leaf at full draw

case_front.rule: The cartridge's front wall, outer face: past the sear's tooth, with room for the front pin

case_top.rule: The cartridge's top: the barrel cartridge's floor sits on it, so the sear's tooth and the sled's tab pass between them

case_h.rule: The cartridge's depth off the bed: the flexures and a fit, to the frame's cavity wall

pin_room.rule: Room along the barrel for a pin's foot inside the front wall

pin_foot.rule: The pins' feet: a flange the pin's diameter across past the shaft, inside the cartridge, which pinches the floor to the frame

pin_a.rule: The pins through the floor into the frame: bottom rear, bottom front, top rear, front. Their x, then their y

pin_b.rule: Bottom front pin, x: ahead of the leaf's root

pin_c.rule: Top rear pin, x: behind the tab's run

pin_c_y.rule: Top rear pin, y: under the top wall, above the leaf's tip at full draw

pin_d.rule: Front pin, x: ahead of the sear

finger_room.rule: The finger's window ahead of the trigger's front stop, along the barrel
